newsitem.title: UK: Amersham ties knot with with Pharmacia unit.
newsitem.headline: Amersham ties knot with with Pharmacia unit.

text.p: British health and science group Amersham International Plc on Tuesday set its sights on becoming the world's biggest supplier of drug discovery technology through a joint venture with Swedish-based Pharmacia Biotech.

Confirmation of a merger between Amersham Life Science and the drug discovery arm of the Swedish-U.S. drug group Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc sent Amersham's shares soaring to record highs in London, rising by 121 1/2 pence to 1472 1/2 in midmorning trade.

Amersham was also boosted by a strong set of full-year results, which showed profits jumping by 30 percent to 65.8 million pounds ($107.6 million) in the year to March as sales of its brain-imaging agent Myoview and a new treatment for prostate cancer took off.

Amersham and Pharmacia, who admitted they were in talks late last month, said they planned to create a new company, Amersham Pharmacia Biotech, based in Sweden. The merger brings together Amersham's skills in specialist chemicals and genetic sequencing with Pharmacia's strength in drug-test machinery.
The new company will have a combined workforce of 3,600 and total sales of around 430 million pounds.
Pharmacia & Upjohn said it had the right to sell its stake in the joint venture from 2000. The company could also eventually be floated on the stock market.
Amersham told Reuters the merger would lead to around 360 job losses over the next two years, with cost savings of 30 million pounds a year expected by 1999. ($ = 0.611 British Pounds)
